articles.title: NASA Selects University Finalists for Technology Concepts Competition
articles.summary: NASA selected 14 university teams from across the nation as finalists in the 2026 Revolutionary Aerospace Systems Concepts – Academic Linkage (RASC-AL) Competition. This NASA challenge tasks students to design innovative concepts that could further human life and work on the Moon, Mars, and beyond. articles.title: OHB Sweden wins €248 million contract to build EPS-Sterna constellation
articles.summary:
OHB Sweden has won a record contract for Sweden’s space sector to build 20 satellites to boost Europe’s weather forecasting and climate monitoring capabilities.
